name: Composite Cross Domain Variant 7
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

=== Stage 1: Information Extraction ===
A foundation's grant report (24 pages): $10M endowment, 5% annual payout. 5 proposals: Education ($200K, 500 students), Health ($300K, 2000 patients), Arts ($150K, 50 artists), Environment ($250K, 1000 acres), Housing ($100K, 50 families).

=== Stage 2: Financial Analysis ===
Calculate NPV of the investment.

=== Stage 3: Resource Allocation ===
Optimize budget allocation.

=== Stage 4: Decision ===
Recommend the best course of action.
